metadata.title: getCss() Regex Bypassable via CSS Comment Injection and Hex Escape Encoding

sources: Field.style string from ApplinX REST API GetScreenResponse (server-controlled)
transformations: Split by ';' to extract CSS declarations
Regex filter !/url\s*\(|expression\s*\(|javascript\s*:/i (bypassable via CSS comments and hex escapes)
sinks: Inline style attribute on FieldComponent <div> via Angular [style] binding
Inline style attribute on InputFieldComponent <input> element

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: Same-origin CSS resource load (data exfiltration via URL parameters only) — LATENT, currently blocked by allowlist

impact.description: CSS comment bypass is real but currently blocked by ALLOWED_CSS_PROPS which has no url()-accepting properties. Latent: a future allowlist addition (background-image, cursor) without fixing the regex enables immediate exploitation. CSS-based exfiltration is limited to URL parameters.

prerequisites: Developer adds url()-accepting property to ALLOWED_CSS_PROPS without fixing regex

compensating_controls: ALLOWED_CSS_PROPS allowlist contains no url()-accepting properties (primary defense, currently effective)

remediation.fix_approach: Pre-normalize CSS values before regex: strip CSS comments (value.replace(/\/\*.*?\*\//gs, '')) and normalize hex escapes. Consider per-property value validators to replace regex entirely.

history.note: getCss() value regex does not block CSS comment injection (url/**/) or hex escape encoding

Regex bypass confirmed. Currently blocked by ALLOWED_CSS_PROPS (no url()-accepting properties). Latent vulnerability — single allowlist addition enables exploitation. Downgraded from HIGH to MEDIUM; CVSS adjusted from 6.1 to 3.4 reflecting required backend compromise + current blocking by allowlist.
